summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of RelaisPoint. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed against public URL covering carriers, points (filter/search/geo-sort/404), auth (register/login/logout/me/cookie), and favorites (auth-guarded CRUD). Frontend: Playwright verified app load with 226 markers, carrier filter (mondial_relay -> 36), city search (Lyon -> 6), full register flow, add-favorite with toast, favorites tab, logout, and unauth fav-click prompts auth modal. No critical bugs found.

issues: French pluralization: '1 points relais' should be '1 point relais' (singular). Cosmetic i18n issue.

action_items: (Optional) Fix pluralization in results-count: use `${n} point${n>1?'s':''} relais`.

(Optional) The MapApp Panel is rendered twice (desktop aside + mobile sheet), producing duplicate data-testid attributes for every point-card/fav-btn/tab/etc. in the DOM at the same time. Playwright still works via first-match, but strictly duplicate testids violate the uniqueness contract. Consider gating the mobile Panel on a media query or scoping testids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORSMiddleware relies on FRONTEND_URL only; cookies are samesite=none+secure which is correct for cross-site. Good.
seed_admin updates password on hash mismatch (idempotent). Good.
bcrypt hash used (format $2b$) via bcrypt.hashpw. Good.
MongoDB ObjectId serialized via PyObjectId (BeforeValidator str) and user_public wraps _id -> str. No raw ObjectId leaking. Good.
GET /api/points loads all POINTS in memory each call (~226 items); acceptable at this scale but consider caching if data grows.
AuthContext initial state uses null=checking then false=logged out — could momentarily flash UI. Not a bug.
MapApp Panel duplication across desktop/mobile is the only notable code-quality concern (see action items).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@relaispoint.fr / admin123 (verified working). Fresh users are registered per-test with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally; each test run creates a unique TEST_<uuid> user for favorites lifecycle. No cleanup performed (users remain in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be reused as regression suite. Public URL is used (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Frontend Panel is duplicated in DOM (desktop + mobile) so any query_selector_all on data-testid returns 2x elements; use .first or index [0]. Geolocation button exists and is clickable but cannot be truly exercised in headless env — confirmed only presence/click. Map uses Leaflet via /components/MapView.js. All 6 carriers/colors verified via API.
